qualification.statement: Every declared gate step exited 0 except tigerstyle, flake. flake failed in host Nix configuration before building any check and did not pass. tigerstyle failed in the same host Nix build hook while building its runner, before linting; rerun alone over the byte-identical tree, it exited 0. v6 was installed from the release build of the tree the gates hashed at start and end; the pin step refused any tree difference before or during pinning.

prior_cohort_pass.superseded_by: v6 was pinned from the final tree after the Tiger Style fixes in crates/mantle-cargo-unit-plan and crates/crunch-pipeline; identity_with_previous records which executables kept their v5 bytes.

maintenance_owner: Mantle scheduler (crunch-build worker) and store export maintainers
defect: A derivation first admitted as a dependency and later requested as a streamed root was reported without a physical export ("reported build output is missing"), and a root requested after its dependency finished was not reported as a root result.

discovered_by.scenario: native dynamic-plan production smoke v5 (lexical producer fixture repaired)
